market.question: Will the highest temperature in Karachi be 34°C on April 28?

assessment.reasoning: Multiple sources forecast Karachi's April 28 high at 91°F (~33°C) at the Masroor Airbase area. The market asks for exactly 34°C (whole-degree reporting). Karachi late-April historically averages 33-35°C, so 34°C is plausible but the central forecast of 33°C makes it a roughly 1-in-5 shot given forecast uncertainty at 2-day horizon.
data_sources: Historical climate-data.org late April Karachi averages ~33-35°C
